title: Supabase Batch Runtime / Scheduling
summary: Phase 1 complete: Cron → Database Function and Cron → Edge Function are verified; Edge Function → Native Data API SELECT/UPDATE on the authorized synthetic table is verified. Formal place read is blocked by service_role table privilege, so the scheduled external API path has not yet been reached. Phase 2 will verify backend service access and Cron-scheduled outbound HTTP, then run one minimal integrated chain.
flow: Phase 1: Cron A → Database Function → PENDING; Cron B → Edge Function → Data API synthetic SELECT/UPDATE verified, formal place read blocked by privilege. Phase 2: backend service access + scheduled external API + minimal integration confirmation.
